messages:
Maria: quick update — we rolled out conflux-packer v1.2 as a 10% canary on prod @ 02:00 UTC. early bench looks solid: p50 down ~26%, p99 down ~14% for short requests, cost/unit down ~11%. rolling to 100% if canary stays green :tada:
Ryan: nice! can you paste the raw numbers or a short table?
Maria: sure, pasted the quick table below (canary vs baseline):
```
model | p50 before -> after | p99 before -> after | cost/token
rwd-7b | 48ms -> 35ms | 235ms -> 202ms | 1.00 -> 0.89
rwd-13b | 72ms -> 54ms | 412ms -> 358ms | 1.00 -> 0.92
short-chat (seq<128) mix | 34ms -> 25ms | 190ms -> 165ms | 1.00 -> 0.88
```
Ryan: wow, 13b p50 down 25% is impressive. what's the worker-side impact (cpu/mem)?
Maria: worker CPU +6% on average for the canary nodes due to merge overhead, mem unchanged. net cost saving is still positive because fewer tokens spent in queues and shorter tail latency. no spike in GC or oom logs so far.
Chloe: any observed regressions or error-rate blips during the canary?
Maria: deploy-bot forwarded canary-checks, all green except one transient 502 during a spike (handled by retry policy). deploy-bot summary: 
```
{"canary_id":"conflux-2791","duration_min":45,"checks":{"latency":true,"errors":true,"throughput":true},"failures":1}
```
Chloe: OK that's acceptable. what's the feature flag flip plan?
Maria: plan: 10% -> 30% in 2h -> 60% in 6h -> 100% in 24h if no alerts. fallback: immediate flag off + route to legacy packer. I'm adding an automated rollback if p99 > 350ms for >5m.
Kevin: great work team. can you capture a 2-slide before/after plus one slide on fallback & cost impact for next all-hands? also coordinate with docs for the config snippet.
Maria: will do. GA target = 2 weeks pending full rollout metrics. tagging @ryan for the ops playbook edit.
Ryan: adding an incident-safe playbook now (short checklist + runbook).
Chloe: :tada: love it. please add a short note to the release channel when we hit 100%.
Maria: will post a full postmortem-style bench summary to #eng-docs and link to the PR: https://github.internal/r/redwood/runtime/pulls/4821
Kevin: thanks — can we get a quick one-liner for the exec roundup?
Maria: "Conflux-packer v1.2 reduced short-request p50 by ~26% and p99 by ~14%, cutting unit inference cost by ~11% in early canary — GA planned in 2 weeks if rollout holds."
Ryan: nailed it.
deploy-bot: canary-monitoring: next check in 15m.
Maria: ack, leaving the canary watch on. ping me in thread for anything urgent.
